metadata.name: loss_cover_hook
metadata.description: Bordrless Loss cover hook: a token hook that keeps each holding's average entry price, what it holds and the cover it was paid, so the Loss cover script can pay holders who are under water from the companion's pot. It never refuses a transfer, takes no cut and never sees SOL.

docs: Instructions of the Loss cover hook.

instructions.name: before_burn
docs: `before_burn`: the reference moved when due, the burner's record cut as for a send.

instructions.name: before_transfer
docs: `before_transfer`: the reference moved when due; the sender's record cut to what it keeps
(the cover paid pro rata with it), the receiver's basis blended at the trade's price (a buy
out of the pool: what it paid, uncapped) or the spot (any other transfer); each answered as
the holding's hook data when its owner may hold a record. Never takes a cut, never refuses a
SOL coin's transfer. On a coin quoted in tokens each price is the record leg's, and a
transfer without the accounts it needs is refused (the module).

instructions.name: prepare
docs: Prepares the hook for `mint`, which need not exist yet (a launch's mint: the launchpad
creates it naming this program as its hook): the state and the extra-accounts registry. The
launch pool's address follows from the launchpad's config (its LP fee). The mint's keypair
signs; once per mint.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint the hook is prepared for (not created yet); its keypair signs.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The launchpad's config (address-checked): its LP fee is a seed of the launch's pool.

instructions.name: prepare_legs
docs: `prepare` for a coin quoted in tokens (`docs/token-quotes.md` §7.6): the same state and
accounts, then the coin's legs' pools, in leg order, as remaining accounts (1 to 6; their
keys are written, not read: the pools need not exist yet). The state's `pool` is leg 0's,
`reserved[0]` the number of legs; the registry lists the state, the launch, leg 0's pool, the
coin's `Legs` and the other legs' pools.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint the hook is prepared for (not created yet); its keypair signs.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The launchpad's config (address-checked): its LP fee is a seed of the launch's pool.

instructions.name: record_payout
docs: The companion's payout authority alone: records `lamports` of cover paid to `holding` (0: a
touch) in round `tag` (on a coin quoted in tokens, raw units of the record leg's token). The
holding is of this mint, its owner may hold a record and the record exists; the record is
written through the token program.

accounts.name: payout_authority
docs: The companion program's `PDA(["payout-authority"])`, signing by CPI.

accounts.name: holding
docs: `mint`; the token program writes its hook data.

instructions.name: set_entry
docs: This program's upgrade authority alone (read from its ProgramData): sets `holding`'s
recorded entry to `entry` (lamports per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`; on a coin quoted in
tokens raw units of the record leg's token), the repair of a record an earlier rule wrote
wrong. The balance, the cover paid, the round, the basis time, the leg and the flags stay;
the slot is stamped. The holding is of this mint, its owner may hold a record, the record
exists and `entry` is not 0. Written through the token program, signed by this program's
`["hook-authority"]`, as `record_payout` writes.

accounts.name: authority
docs: This program's upgrade authority (as its ProgramData names it).

accounts.name: holding
docs: `mint`; the token program writes its hook data.

accounts.name: state
docs: The mint's state: who never holds a record.

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one this mint's hook expects

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer is not the token program's signer for this hook

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the holding is of another mint

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: this owner holds no record: the launch, its pool, the companion's creator address, or an address off the ed25519 curve

errors.name: NotTheCompanion
errors.msg: only the companion program's payout authority records a payout

errors.name: NoRecord
errors.msg: this holding has no record to pay against

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: only this program's upgrade authority, as its ProgramData names it, sets an entry

errors.name: ZeroEntry
errors.msg: an entry of 0 is no price

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

fields.name: amount
docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

types.name: LossCoverState

fields.name: bump

fields.name: creator

fields.name: paid_total

fields.name: prepared_by

fields.name: reserved

fields.name: destination

fields.name: destination_owner
